changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: A model call request names its workspace, except a product feedback call, which has none. The database now holds this rule, not only the worker that writes the request.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE llm_call_permit DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS ck_llm_call_permit_workspace_by_class
ALTER TABLE llm_call_permit ADD CONSTRAINT ck_llm_call_permit_workspace_by_class CHECK ((workspace_id IS NULL) = (call_class = 'PRODUCT_FEEDBACK'))

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE llm_call_permit DROP CONSTRAINT ck_llm_call_permit_workspace_by_class
